title: BerOS file system
statementMd:
The new operating system BerOS has a nice feature. It is possible to use any number of characters `'/'` as a delimiter in path instead of one traditional `'/'`. For example, strings `//usr///local//nginx/sbin//` and `/usr/local/nginx///sbin` are equivalent. The character `'/'` (or some sequence of such characters) at the end of the path is required only in case of the path to the root directory, which can be represented as single character `'/'`.

A path called normalized if it contains the smallest possible number of characters `'/'`.

Your task is to transform a given path to the normalized form.

## Input

The first line of the input contains only lowercase Latin letters and character `'/'` — the path to some directory. All paths start with at least one character `'/'`. The length of the given line is no more than 100 characters, it is not empty.

## Output

The path in normalized form.
statementZhMd:
BerOS 新操作系统具有一项很棒的功能：在路径中，可以使用任意数量的字符 `'/'` 作为分隔符，而不必使用传统的单个 `'/'`。例如，字符串 `//usr///local//nginx/sbin//` 和 `/usr/local/nginx///sbin` 是等价的。路径末尾的字符 `'/'`（或由这些字符组成的序列）仅在路径指向根目录时是必需的，根目录可以用单个字符 `'/'` 表示。

如果一个路径中包含的字符 `'/'` 数量尽可能少，则称该路径为规范化路径。

你的任务是将给定路径转换为规范化形式。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行仅包含小写拉丁字母和字符 `'/'`，表示某个目录的路径。所有路径都至少以一个字符 `'/'` 开头。给定行的长度不超过 100 个字符，且不为空。

## 输出格式

输出规范化形式的路径。
